prompt: Reference image 1 is the chosen zone roster sheet; reference image 2 is the chosen single HALO CRYSTAL design. Edit only the middle row, the HALO CRYSTAL frames, so it becomes a real animation in which no two frames look alike; keep the top row (the OPTION HUNTER views) and the bottom row (the GLINT MOTE frames) exactly as they are, at the same places, and keep the perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key background. The middle row holds six HALO CRYSTAL frames from left to right, the same design and size as now: the big faceted violet gem, unchanged in every frame, with its ring of six small satellite crystals on the corners of a hexagon, six satellites in every frame, never more. The orbit is shown by one white satellite that travels clockwise around the ring, one position per frame. Frame 1: only the top satellite is white; the other five are violet. Frame 2: only the upper-right satellite is white; the top one is violet again. Frame 3: only the lower-right satellite is white. Frame 4: only the bottom satellite is white. Frame 5: only the lower-left satellite is white. Frame 6: only the upper-left satellite is white. Never more than one white satellite in a frame, and never a frame without one. The white satellite is filled pale white-lilac inside its dark outline, with no glow around it. Crisp pixel art with 1-pixel near-black navy outlines, no anti-aliasing, no lines, borders, arrows, trails, halos or motion marks, no cast shadow, no green spill. No text, letters, numbers, labels, UI or watermark anywhere.
negative: text, labels, numbers, watermark, photorealistic, 3d render, scene background, environment, gradient background, blurry, inconsistent character design, silhouette changing between frames, merged sprites, overlapping rows, organic coral shapes, pure black background, perspective distortion, green tint on the subject, green spill, background scenery, cast shadow
